meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把设计元素变成动态短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文字、数据或标识快速做成短小吸睛的动画片段
copy.tagline_en: Turn design elements into short motion graphics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want quick animated visuals for social posts or presentations.

howto.what: 制作短小、设计主导、无旁白的动态图形视频,如动态文字、数字统计、图表动画、logo 揭示、地图动画、网页/UI 动画等,通常10秒内,渲染为MP4或透明叠加文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作短小的动态图形(如动态文字、图表、logo动画等),或提供Figma链接、网页链接、新闻、推文等素材时触发。

say.text: 把这句话做成10秒的动态文字视频。
say.note: Claude会规划并生成动态文字动画。

say.text: 用这组数据做一个柱状图动画。
say.note: Claude会制作图表动画并渲染视频。

say.text: 给这个logo做一个品牌开场动画。

howto.what_en: Creates short, design-led, unnarrated motion graphics (kinetic typography, stat count-ups, charts, logo reveals, map animations, web/UI animation), typically under 10s, rendered to MP4 or transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests a short motion graphic (e.g., kinetic text, charts, logo sting), or provides a Figma link, webpage, news article, or tweet as source material.
